specialty_focus: Dispensing Solutions, Inc. is a specialized pharmaceutical packager and supply-chain partner based in Santa Ana, California. It provides in-office medication dispensing programs, unit-dose packaging, and distribution services for physician, government, and private-label markets. The company does not appear to deal in wearable medical devices.
